value: Back in Tanaris, Ironboot reads the tablets as evidence that the egg can serve a larger purpose: Hakkar may be reborn in the depths of Zul'Gurub. That is Ironboot's interpretation of the text, not a fact the seeker has yet witnessed. The later manual's account of Zul'Gurub shows why his warning matters, while keeping this warning distinct from the temple avatar's defeat.
editorNote: Original paraphrase. Scene order follows quest-chain order and does not assert exact date or unsupported causal links. Secondary locators and original-client limits are recorded in the research packet.
